_doc: Files carrying prose that spells a banned shape, frozen at the moment scripts/lint/lint_ban_prose.py was introduced (PR successor to #6935, after the refuting seat widened the scope to the C-family suffixes the workflow already triggers on). FILE-level, not finding-level, so an unrelated edit that shifts a line number inside an already-listed file is never read as a new violation. The lint fails when a file OUTSIDE this set gains a violation, and when this list GROWS against the base ref — a PR cannot add an offender and grandfather it away in the same diff. Remediate a file, then delete its line here: shrinking is always allowed.
